title: cline/cline
title_zh: 开源编程代理 Cline 介绍

paragraphs.en: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 作为 SDK、IDE 扩展或 CLI 助手的自主编码智能体。

paragraphs.en: The open source coding agent in your IDE, terminal, & desktop!
paragraphs.zh: 你 IDE、终端和桌面中的开源编码智能体！

paragraphs.en: Run Cline in your terminal. Interactive chat or fully headless for CI/CD and scripting.
paragraphs.zh: 在终端中运行 Cline。 支持交互式聊天，也可完全无界面运行，适用于 CI/CD 和脚本场景。

sents.en: Run Cline in your terminal.
sents.zh: 在终端中运行 Cline。

sents.en: Interactive chat or fully headless for CI/CD and scripting.
sents.zh: 支持交互式聊天，也可完全无界面运行，适用于 CI/CD 和脚本场景。

paragraphs.en: Cline as a native app for macOS and Windows. Run agent sessions in any folder, schedule routines, and manage models, plugins, and MCP servers.
paragraphs.zh: Cline 是一款适用于 macOS 和 Windows 的原生应用。 在任意文件夹中运行智能体会话、安排例行任务，并管理模型、插件和 MCP 服务器。

sents.en: Run agent sessions in any folder, schedule routines, and manage models, plugins, and MCP servers.
sents.zh: 在任意文件夹中运行智能体会话、安排例行任务，并管理模型、插件和 MCP 服务器。

paragraphs.en: AI coding assistant in your editor. Create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval.
paragraphs.zh: 编辑器中的 AI 编程助手。 创建文件、运行命令、浏览网页并使用工具，均需人工在环路中批准。

sents.en: AI coding assistant in your editor.
sents.zh: 编辑器中的 AI 编程助手。

sents.en: Create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval.
sents.zh: 创建文件、运行命令、浏览网页并使用工具，均需人工在环路中批准。

paragraphs.en: The same Cline experience in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and the rest of the JetBrains family.
paragraphs.zh: 在 IntelliJ IDEA、PyCharm、WebStorm、GoLand 以及 JetBrains 家族的其他 IDE 中体验同样的 Cline。

paragraphs.en: Build your own AI agents and integrations powered by the same engine that runs the CLI, desktop app, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin. Custom tools, multi-agent teams, connectors, scheduled automations, and more.
paragraphs.zh: 构建您自己的智能体和集成，它们由驱动 CLI、桌面应用、VS Code 扩展和 JetBrains 插件的同一引擎提供支持。 自定义工具、多智能体团队、连接器、定时自动化等等。

sents.en: Build your own AI agents and integrations powered by the same engine that runs the CLI, desktop app, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin.
sents.zh: 构建您自己的智能体和集成，它们由驱动 CLI、桌面应用、VS Code 扩展和 JetBrains 插件的同一引擎提供支持。

sents.en: Custom tools, multi-agent teams, connectors, scheduled automations, and more.
sents.zh: 自定义工具、多智能体团队、连接器、定时自动化等等。

paragraphs.en: Cline reads your project structure, understands the relationships between files, and makes coordinated changes across your codebase. It monitors linter and compiler errors as it works, fixing issues like missing imports, type mismatches, and syntax errors before you even see them. In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert. All changes are tracked with checkpoints, so you can easily undo the agent's work.
paragraphs.zh: Cline 会读取你的项目结构，理解文件之间的关系，并在整个代码库中进行协调一致的修改。 它在工作过程中会监控 linter 和编译器错误，在你尚未察觉之前就修复诸如缺失导入、类型不匹配和语法错误等问题。 在 VS Code 和 JetBrains 中，每一次编辑都会以 diff 的形式呈现，你可以审查、修改或回滚。 所有更改都通过检查点进行跟踪，因此你可以轻松撤销智能体所做的工作。

paragraphs.en: Cline executes commands directly in your terminal and watches the output in real time. Install packages, run build scripts, execute tests, deploy applications, manage databases. For long-running processes like dev servers, Cline continues working in the background and reacts to new output as it appears, catching compile errors, test failures, and server crashes as they happen.
paragraphs.zh: Cline 直接在你的终端中执行命令，并实时查看输出。 安装软件包、运行构建脚本、执行测试、部署应用、管理数据库。 对于开发服务器这类长时间运行的进程，Cline 会在后台持续工作，并在新输出出现时作出反应，即时捕获编译错误、测试失败和服务器崩溃。

sents.en: Cline executes commands directly in your terminal and watches the output in real time.
sents.zh: Cline 直接在你的终端中执行命令，并实时查看输出。

sents.en: Install packages, run build scripts, execute tests, deploy applications, manage databases.
sents.zh: 安装软件包、运行构建脚本、执行测试、部署应用、管理数据库。

sents.en: For long-running processes like dev servers, Cline continues working in the background and reacts to new output as it appears, catching compile errors, test failures, and server crashes as they happen.

paragraphs.en: Toggle between Plan mode and Act mode. In Plan mode, Cline explores your codebase, asks clarifying questions, and lays out a strategy. Once you're aligned, switch to Act mode and Cline executes the plan. Every file edit and terminal command requires your approval, so you stay in control of what actually changes. Or toggle auto-approve and let Cline run autonomously.
paragraphs.zh: 在「计划模式」和「执行模式」之间切换。 在计划模式下，Cline 会探索你的代码库，提出澄清性问题，并制定出策略。 当你们达成一致后，切换到执行模式，Cline 就会执行计划。 每次文件编辑和终端命令都需要你的批准，因此你能始终掌控实际发生的更改。 或者开启自动批准，让 Cline 自主运行。

paragraphs.en: Define project-specific rules in .clinerules files that guide how Cline works in your codebase: coding standards, architecture conventions, deployment procedures, testing requirements. Rules are picked up automatically by the CLI, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin. Use skills to let the model load specific rules when needed.
paragraphs.zh: 在 .clinerules 文件中定义项目专属规则，以指导 Cline 在你的代码库中的工作方式：编码规范、架构约定、部署流程、测试要求。 这些规则会被 CLI、VS Code 扩展和 JetBrains 插件自动读取。 使用技能（skills）让模型在需要时加载特定规则。

paragraphs.en: Extend Cline's capabilities with plugins. Using the SDK, register tools and lifecycle hooks programmatically through the plugin system for logging, auditing, policy enforcement, or adding domain-specific capabilities. Simple plugin example below.
paragraphs.zh: 通过插件扩展 Cline 的能力。 借助 SDK，可以通过插件系统以编程方式注册工具和生命周期钩子，用于日志记录、审计、策略执行，或添加特定领域的能力。 下面是一个简单的插件示例。

sents.en: Extend Cline's capabilities with plugins.
sents.zh: 通过插件扩展 Cline 的能力。

sents.en: Using the SDK, register tools and lifecycle hooks programmatically through the plugin system for logging, auditing, policy enforcement, or adding domain-specific capabilities.
sents.zh: 借助 SDK，可以通过插件系统以编程方式注册工具和生命周期钩子，用于日志记录、审计、策略执行，或添加特定领域的能力。

sents.en: Simple plugin example below.
sents.zh: 下面是一个简单的插件示例。

paragraphs.en: import { Agent , createTool } from "@cline/sdk" const deployTool = createTool ( { name : "deploy" , description : "Deploy the current branch to staging." , inputSchema : { type : "object" , properties : { env : { type : "string" } } , required : [ "env" ] } , execute : async ( input ) => { // your deployment logic } , } ) const agent = new Agent ( { tools : [ deployTool ] , /* ... */ } ) ...or use MCPs to connect to databases, query APIs, manage cloud infrastructure, and interact with external systems. Use community-built servers or ask Cline to create custom tools on the fly. In the CLI, manage servers with cline mcp .
paragraphs.zh: import { Agent, createTool } from "@cline/sdk" const deployTool = createTool({ name: "deploy", description: "将当前分支部署到预发布环境。", inputSchema: { type: "object", properties: { env: { type: "string" } }, required: ["env"] }, execute: async (input) => { // 你的部署逻辑 }, }) const agent = new Agent({ tools: [deployTool], /* ... */ }) …或者使用 MCP 连接数据库、查询 API、管理云基础设施，并与外部系统交互。 使用社区构建的服务器，或让 Cline 即时创建自定义工具。 在 CLI 中，使用 cline mcp 管理服务器。

paragraphs.en: Coordinate multiple agents working together on complex tasks. A coordinator agent breaks the work into subtasks and delegates to specialist agents, each with their own tools and context. Team state persists across sessions so you can pick up where you left off.
paragraphs.zh: 协调多个智能体共同完成复杂任务。 协调者智能体将工作拆分为子任务并分派给专家智能体，每个专家智能体拥有自己的工具和上下文。 团队状态在会话之间持久保存，因此你可以从上次中断的地方继续。

paragraphs.en: cline --team-name auth-sprint " Plan and implement user authentication with tests " Scheduled Agents Run agents on cron schedules for recurring automations. Daily PR summaries, weekly dependency checks, codebase health reports. Schedules persist across restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
paragraphs.zh: cline --team-name auth-sprint "规划并实现用户身份验证，并附带测试" 定时智能体（Scheduled Agents）按 cron 计划运行智能体，实现周期性自动化。 每日 PR 摘要、每周依赖检查、代码库健康报告。 计划在重启后依然保留，并独立于任何终端会话运行。

sents.en: Schedules persist across restarts and run independently of any terminal session.
sents.zh: 计划在重启后依然保留，并独立于任何终端会话运行。

paragraphs.en: cline schedule create " PR summary " \ --cron " 0 9 * * MON-FRI " \ --prompt " List all open PRs and their review status " \ --workspace /path/to/repo Connect to Slack, Telegram, Discord, and More Chat with your agent from any messaging platform: Telegram, Slack, Discord, Google Chat, WhatsApp, and Linear. Each conversation thread maps to an agent session with full context. Set up access control to restrict who can interact with your agent.
paragraphs.zh: cline schedule create "PR 摘要" \ --cron "0 9 * * MON-FRI" \ --prompt "列出所有开放的 PR 及其审查状态" \ --workspace /path/to/repo 连接 Slack、Telegram、Discord 以及更多平台 从任何消息平台与你的智能体对话：Telegram、Slack、Discord、Google Chat、WhatsApp 和 Linear。 每个对话线程都映射到一个具有完整上下文的智能体会话。 设置访问控制以限制谁可以与你的智能体交互。
